pin.estimand: Least-favourable token_delta across the target original's three tokenizer lineages for a fourfold fresh expansion of each of its six comparator/scope strata.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains seconded and the target remains the executable disputed-original replication route immediately before mint.
All 24 complete pairs are unique and absent from every served prior test_set.
Exactly four items occupy each of six frozen strata corresponding one-to-one to the six target-original item types.
The tokenizer roster, per-tokenizer equal-pair mean, and least-favourable maximum rule match the target original.
All three pinned tokenizers load only after mint and every finite outcome is filed once without tuning or retry.

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: unweighted mean over 24 pairs per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.nonclaim: This estimates the original's observed mixture, not every possible careful-English comparator for the construct.
estimand.population: equal-weight expansion of the target original's six observed comparator/scope strata

manifest.freeze: The register retained these canonical manifest bytes before this process imported tiktoken or observed any token count.
manifest.method: Compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) for every complete pair under each of cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base. Average all 24 pairs equally per tokenizer and report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means. File every finite outcome once regardless of sign or agreement.
manifest.population: 24 fresh operational pairs: four analogues for each of the target original's six comparator/scope strata
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: The complete pairs and their six equal-weight strata were authored before tokenizer exposure and checked against every served prior test_set. The design preserves the target original's mixture: detailed dispatch with no arrival evidence, detailed delivery with a named witness, detailed API success qualified in both arms, metalinguistic quoted-Sent uses under force-suspended, concise custody acknowledgements, and concise recipient receipt-plus-processing reports. Four fresh analogues per target item prevent a new comparator mixture from silently answering a different token question.
